description.fr-FR: Lettres de Bossuet découvertes après la publication des tomes précédents (à M. de Lagutère, à Mme de Maintenon, correspondance de Malebranche), et les mémoires et lettres de 1702 au cardinal de Noailles et au chancelier sur l’impression des ouvrages de doctrine des évêques. Édition Lachat (1864), tomes XXX-XXXI.
description.en-US: Letters by Bossuet discovered after the earlier volumes were printed (to M. de Lagutère, to Madame de Maintenon, the Malebranche correspondence), and the memoranda and letters of 1702 to Cardinal de Noailles and the Chancellor on the printing of bishops’ doctrinal works. Lachat edition (1864), volumes XXX-XXXI.
description.pt-BR: Cartas de Bossuet descobertas depois da impressão dos tomos anteriores (ao sr. de Lagutère, à sra. de Maintenon, correspondência de Malebranche) e os memoriais e cartas de 1702 ao cardeal de Noailles e ao chanceler sobre a impressão das obras de doutrina dos bispos. Edição Lachat (1864), tomos XXX-XXXI.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXX page 018 (Nouvelles lettres) and volume XXXI page 003 (Mémoires et lettres de 1702). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
